mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit margins and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing output, which increases recession risk and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO < 100 fails to predict negative 60d SPX returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS and 5d SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST < 1600 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between INDPRO and 60d SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.
